• The word **"Seperate"** is incorrectly spelt.
 
• The correct spelling is "**Separate**", which means to divide or keep apart. (अलग करना)
 
• **​"Separate" **refers to causing something to move or be apart from something else. (अलग करना)
 
 
• **Example: **They decided to **separate **the two groups for the activities.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 4**.

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Receive **(प्राप्त करना): To get or be given something.

 
 
• **Example:** I was happy to **receive **your letter.
 
 
 
• **Vacuum **(शून्य): A space entirely devoid of matter.
 
 
• **Example: **The **vacuum **cleaner is very effective at removing dust.
 
 
 
• **Weird** (अजीब): Something that is very strange or unusual.
 
 
• **Example:** I had a **weird **dream last night.
